Measure identical native hot paths with and without embedded-runtime startup and separately report checked VM/AOT invocation, lookup, injection/compilation, publication and startup costs. Whole-binary differences are expected after embedding the VM; no existing VM-free binary identity or finite benchmark proves universal Rust-speed parity.

A finite language-fragment corpus retains every raw sample and reports all empirical integer percentiles p0 through p100 plus p99.9 with sample counts and nearest-rank definition. Validate a known rare pause and bound probe I/O/work. Empirical maxima or small samples do not qualify population tails, independent-build confidence or universal all-percentile improvement.

Small performance changes require same-binary controls, actual repeated builds and paired repeated process runs with retained order and binary identities. Measure parsing, checked-projection compilation and canonical printing separately with matched source/artifact identities, all empirical ranks, raw samples and explicit canonical-output changes.

Public API adapters preserve common semantics, unavailable routes remain unavailable, and all measured percentile regressions remain visible.
